migration_order: 1. core/server/mike_server_middleware.py (no deps on other new modules)
2. core/server/mike_notifications.py (pure asyncio, no deps on other new modules)
8. core/memory/mike_memory_utils.py (extracted first, no deps on other memory modules)
11. core/server/mike_singletons.py (REVISED: move roadmap/backup helpers + wrapper fns here)
13. core/server/mike_chat_core.py (depends on mike_singletons, mike_lazy_factories, most modules)
15. mike_server.py (reduced to ~300 lines: app creation, router/middleware registration, static mount, main)
risks: Circular dependency: mike_singletons imports from mike_config and produces wrappers that mike_chat_core needs; mike_chat_core is imported by routers which are registered in mike_server.py. Use shared_state bridge pattern already in place.

mike_chat_core.py is the riskiest extraction — it contains the streaming loop, tool orchestration, and TaskMesh integration. Must verify streaming behavior (SSE keepalive, tool-call detection, reasoning-leak suppression) after extraction.
mike_lifecycle.py _startup() initializes llm/module-router/fallback-chain global variables that other modules read via shared_state. Ensure shared_state synchronization is preserved.

The 23 keyword sets at the top of the chat helpers block (WEB_SEARCH_KEYWORDS, EMAIL_ROUTE_KEYWORDS, etc.) are module-scoped constants. Moving them to mike_chat_core.py is safe since they are immutable.

mike_memory_store.py is the bulk of mike_memory.py (LocalMikeStore ~1450 lines). Splitting vectors/mesh from it would mean extracting _methods_ from a class that shares a SQLite connection — risky. The plan keeps LocalMikeStore intact in one module and only pulls utility functions out.

Existing routers (chat.py, tools.py, autonomy.py) use from mike_server import ... lazy imports. After split, these must be updated to import from the new modules. All 35+ lazy-import sites need updating.

The _conversation helpers (_save_conversation, _maybe_direct_answer_for_tool_result, email scoring) are tightly coupled to memory_service and monitor/learner singleton access. These stay in mike_chat_core.py since they are chat-loop-adjacent, not standalone.

Soul loading (_get_soul_block, _load_system_prompt, SOUL_PROMPT, SYSTEM_PROMPT) could move to mike_context.py to reduce mike_server.py further. Currently at top of mike_server.py, they are imported by mike_chat_core.py. Suggested migration: mike_context gains get_soul_block/load_system_prompt, mike_server keeps thin wrappers.
summary:
SPLIT PLAN: mike_server.py (4286 lines) -> 10 new modules + ~300 line shim. mike_memory.py (2230 lines) -> 3 new modules.

SERVER SPLIT:
1. mike_chat_core.py (~1450 lines): The core — chat loop, streaming, tool orchestration, keyword matching, search routes, TaskMesh, TreeOfThoughts. Moves lines 934-2461 from mike_server.py.
2. mike_lifecycle.py (~600 lines): _startup(), lifespan(), _proactive_monitor_loop, _drive_index_loop, _auto_cleanup_clutter. Moves lines 2463-3087.
3. mike_lazy_factories.py (~380 lines): All _get_*() and _make_*() lazy-init factories (output guard, virtual context, skills, curriculum, governance, consciousness, verifier, missions, autonomy, monitor, learner, agent registry, SDK generate/execute). Moves lines 3446-3815.
4. mike_routes_knowledge.py (~130 lines): /v1/knowledge/reindex, /v1/knowledge/upsert, /v1/drive/index, /v1/web/search, /tunnel-url, /v1/events/stats, /v1/client/bootstrap, /v1/roadmap, /v1/backups. Moves lines 3209-3378.
5. mike_routes_graph.py (~45 lines): /v1/graph/* endpoints. Moves lines 3384-3419.
6. mike_routes_tts.py (~50 lines): /v1/tts endpoint + TtsRequest model. Moves lines 3825-3868.
7. mike_routes_install.py (~170 lines): /install/{profile_key} + shortcut + HTML template. Moves lines 4120-4280.
8. mike_server_middleware.py (~75 lines): mike_auth_middleware, mike_security_headers_middleware. Moves lines 3111-3173.
9. mike_notifications.py (~25 lines): _broadcast_notification + queue management. Moves lines 3426-3440.
10. mike_dashboard_handlers.py (~160 lines): Dashboard HTML handlers + chat wrapper functions for routers. Moves lines 3999-4117.
11. mike_server.py REMAINING (~300 lines): Soul loading, logging setup, service singletons init, wrapper functions (bridge payload_helpers), app creation, rate limiting, CORS, router registration, static mount, main.

MEMORY SPLIT:
1. mike_memory_utils.py (~270 lines): _read_text_file, _sanitize_query, keyword sets, _prefers_direct_answer, _chunk_section, chunk_text, _contains_any_phrase, _looks_like_simple_math_query.
2. mike_memory_store.py (~1450 lines): Full LocalMikeStore class — SQLite tables, conversations CRUD, FTS, conversation embeddings, knowledge indexing/embeddings, vector search (conversation + knowledge), memory mesh, session checkpoints, session summaries.
3. mike_memory_service.py (~580 lines): MikeMemoryService facade — delegates to LocalMikeStore, Mem0, LightRAG, Reranker, Graph; RRF fusion, build_context, web cache management, Mem0 bootstrap, should_promote_to_mem0.
